name: SpotiSync
description: Matches the songs of your Spotify playlists and Liked Songs against your Jellyfin music library and keeps Jellyfin playlists in sync (mirror or add-only). Manual overrides, missing-song lists, scheduled task. Light on resources: no background work between syncs.
overview: Sync your Spotify playlists into Jellyfin playlists

versions.changelog: First release of SpotiSync for Jellyfin 12.2.
